# Drawlib Quickstart Guide

> 16-chapter engineering onboarding guide for Drawlib v0.3.10 covering primitives, 34 icon suites, SmartArts, 10 charts, diagrams, auto-layout graphs, animations, 5 project archetypes, and AI workflows.

- [8. Quantitative Charts: 10 Pure-Python Chart Types](https://www.drawlib.com/quickstart/en/#chapter-9-08_charts): Technical whitepapers, benchmark reports, and architecture reviews rarely stop at box-and-arrow diagrams—they need rigorous quantitative evidence.…
- [9. Cloud & System Architecture Diagrams](https://www.drawlib.com/quickstart/en/#chapter-10-09_diagrams_cloud): Distributed systems are defined by trust boundaries, network topologies, and service dependencies. drawlib.diagrams.architecture turns cloud infrastructure…

- [11. Automatic Graph Layout Solvers](https://www.drawlib.com/quickstart/en/#chapter-12-11_auto_layout_graphs): When diagrams grow beyond a handful of hand-placed nodes, manually maintaining (x, y) coordinates becomes tedious—yet opaque black-box graph renderers strip…
- [12. Multi-Frame Animations & 16:9 Slide Decks](https://www.drawlib.com/quickstart/en/#chapter-13-12_animations_and_slides): Static diagrams capture architecture snapshots, while time-stepped animations and widescreen presentations explain how systems evolve in motion. Drawlib…
- [13. Documentation as Code & The 5 Project Archetypes](https://www.drawlib.com/quickstart/en/#chapter-14-13_doc_as_code_and_projects): Writing standalone diagrams is only half the story. In real engineering organizations, architecture visuals live inside multi-chapter design documents…
- [14. CLI Toolchain & Autonomous AI Agent Workflows](https://www.drawlib.com/quickstart/en/#chapter-15-14_cli_and_ai_workflow): Drawlib is engineered from the ground up for both human developers and multimodal AI coding assistants. Because every diagram, document, and slide deck…
- [15. Visual Design Rules & Production Checklist](https://www.drawlib.com/quickstart/en/#chapter-16-15_best_practices): Great technical diagrams communicate system architecture in under three seconds—not by adding decorative colors, but through disciplined typography scaling…
